WITH d2_filtered AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2001
    AND d_moy = 8
),
filtered_returns AS (
  SELECT sr.*
  FROM store_returns sr
  JOIN d2_filtered d2
    ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
)
SELECT
  s.s_store_name,
  s.s_company_id,
  s.s_street_number,
  s.s_street_name,
  s.s_street_type,
  s.s_suite_number,
  s.s_city,
  s.s_county,
  s.s_state,
  s.s_zip,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.days <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.days > 30 AND t.days <= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.days > 60 AND t.days <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.days > 90 AND t.days <= 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days",
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.days > 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days"
FROM (
  SELECT
    ss.ss_store_sk,
    fr.sr_returned_date_sk - ss.ss_sold_date_sk AS days
  FROM filtered_returns fr
  JOIN store_sales ss
    ON ss.ss_ticket_number = fr.sr_ticket_number
   AND ss.ss_item_sk = fr.sr_item_sk
   AND ss.ss_customer_sk = fr.sr_customer_sk
  JOIN date_dim d1
    ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
) t
JOIN store s
  ON t.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
GROUP BY
  s.s_store_name,
  s.s_company_id,
  s.s_street_number,
  s.s_street_name,
  s.s_street_type,
  s.s_suite_number,
  s.s_city,
  s.s_county,
  s.s_state,
  s.s_zip
ORDER BY
  s.s_store_name,
  s.s_company_id,
  s.s_street_number,
  s.s_street_name,
  s.s_street_type,
  s.s_suite_number,
  s.s_city,
  s.s_county,
  s.s_state,
  s.s_zip
LIMIT 100
